start_here: Say to your AI: "Book the 10 AM time." It runs tool:choose-a-bookings-time, which keeps the chosen time when it is still open.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it works on the form_rows the pursuit database you name already holds, and a sitting is one row there.
instructions: 1. Name the pursuit database that holds the form rows, such as example_for_who_runs_it; the computer opens it with the login its vault holds.
2. Say what you want in plain words; your AI calls tools:run with tool tool:choose-a-bookings-time and the input.
3. Read the answer and show it with the page's screen; the tool reads and changes one sitting.

worked_examples.title: Choose a booking's time
worked_examples.given: The database holds the page and form rows the step reads (made-up values).
